description:
End a bounty and receive its cancellation quote: what is quoted back and what each hired worker keeps.
Use for: ending a bounty. Use preview: true for a quote. If confirmation_required, call again with only bountyId, confirmationToken and the same idempotencyKey within 5 minutes. If processing, retry with the same key. Check returned money with get_wallet and list_wallet_transactions. Every call counts toward the daily limit, shared with edits.
Not for: ending one hire (cancel_hire); work that was not done (open_dispute).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: cancel_bounty({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp","reason":"not_enough_applicants","idempotencyKey":"5f0c7a2e-8d4b-4e1a-9c3f-2b6d1e8a7f40"})
Key: the idempotencyKey in the example is a sample. Replace it with a new unique key for each new call, and keep that key for the call’s retries and any confirmation it asks for.
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: not_cancellable, confirmation_expired, refund_changed, cancellation_in_progress, idempotency_key_reused; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

confirmationToken.description: The token of a confirmation_required reply. Send it with bountyId only, and an idempotencyKey as on every call, within 5 minutes, to carry out that cancellation. The token decides which cancellation is carried out: the key sent with it is not compared.

details.description: Your own words, needed when reason is other and refused with any other reason. Up to 500 characters.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

preview.description: true returns the quote and a confirmationToken and never starts a cancellation. A cancellation that was already confirmed and is still being finished may be finished by any call, this one included; the reply then says cancelled or processing. Default false.

reason.description: Why you are ending the bounty. Needed on every call without a confirmationToken: there is no default.

name: cancel_bounty

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

bonuses.description: The part of quotedTotal quoted for bonuses nobody earned.

quoted.description: What the cancellation quotes back for this hire. Like quotedTotal, it is a quote and can be a card payment that was never completed.

serviceFee.description: What the quote keeps as service fee for this hire. Like workerPay, it is part of the quote, not a record of a charge.

workerPay.description: What the quote gives the worker of this hire. It is part of the quote, not a record of a payment: the worker is paid only when the cancellation is carried out.

quotedTotal.description: What the cancellation quotes back: unfilledSpots, bonuses and the quoted amount of every hire. It is a quote, not a record of money that came back. It can include card payments that were never completed, and it can leave out a platform cost that comes back with the pool. The wallet is the record of what came back: read it with get_wallet and list_wallet_transactions.

unfilledSpots.description: The part of quotedTotal quoted for spots with no hire.

status.description: confirmation_required: nothing was cancelled; call again with only bountyId and confirmationToken, and the same idempotencyKey, which is still required. cancelled: done; book the quote once. A repeat may return not_cancellable; verify returned money with get_wallet and list_wallet_transactions. processing: the cancellation is saved and not finished; call again with the same key, or the same token, to finish it.

title: Cancel a bounty
